title: 第11章 大罗商盟玄阳大师第12章 九阳回春丹
content_zh:
浩瀚的神光散去，葬天界内终于恢复了平静。
此刻的苏尘，七窍流血，看上去极为狼狈。
但苏尘还是凭借着超强的意志力，坚持了下来，顺利完成了传承。
他已经得到了混元丹经的全部传承！
各种丹方、灵药配比、控火手法、丹道奥妙，全部都清晰的烙印在他的识海之中。
“不错！”
白衣女子淡淡点了点头，随后又飘然消失。
离开葬天界后的苏尘，睡了一觉就恢复了过来，而且生龙活虎，连眼神中都散发出慑人的精光。
“我的精神力居然增强了一大截！”
这个发现，使得苏尘颇为惊喜。
炼丹师最重要的，就是强大的精神力了。
精神力共分为九阶，只有精神力极度凝练，达到一阶之境，才有机会修炼丹道，成为炼丹师。
其中一二阶精神力对应炼丹师，三四阶精神力对应炼丹大师，五六阶精神力对应丹道宗师。
至于七阶精神力以上，则被称之为丹道圣者，超凡入圣，拥有着种种神秘莫测的威能。
苏尘的精神力原本就极为不凡，经过混元丹神残留的精神力量的淬炼，精神力赫然达到了三阶巅峰，已然媲美炼丹大师了。
但这些都只是小场面，真正的大收获还是那篇混元丹经。
混元丹经囊括了混元丹神一生的炼丹经验，古老的特效丹方，甚至是掌握天地奇火的强大手段。
三昧真火印！
以自身精气神为基，造化火印，凝天地奇火！
“这就是混元丹神独创的控火神术，修炼到大成之后，竟然连天地奇火都能够化为己用，不愧是丹神！”

苏尘深吸了一口气，赞叹道。
对一个炼丹师而言，除了强大的精神力，熟练的炼丹技巧和经验之外，最重要的就是控火之法了。
一些高明的控火之法，甚至能将凡火发挥出真火甚至天火的威能。
不仅能大幅提升炼丹的成功率，缩短炼丹时间，甚至还能提高丹药的品质。
毫不客气的说，一个普通炼丹师和一个掌握控火之法的炼丹师，同时炼制一种丹药，其品质也是云泥之别。
而且控火之法，乃是炼丹师的看家绝技，轻易是不会传授出去的。
所以会的人，也极其稀少。
混元丹神独创的三昧真火印，绝对是天地间最为顶级的控火法门。
就算是一个不会炼丹的人，掌握此法，也能一跃成为炼丹大师！
嗡嗡嗡……
按照混元丹经中记载的方法，苏尘经历过一次次失败之后，终于驾御自身精气神的力量，在泥丸宫中，凝练出了一道浅淡的神秘法印。
那就是三昧真火印的雏形，虽然还只是最初级的淡红色，但随着苏尘一次次耗费精气神凝练，火焰的雏形还是渐渐稳固了下来。
“这三昧真火印还真是厉害！
我的真气、肉身血脉和精神力量都远超常人，修炼起来居然还如此费劲。”
仅仅凝聚出雏形，苏尘就感觉身体被掏空，彻底的虚脱了。
直到第二天悠悠醒来，他手掌一翻，顿时有一道玄奥复杂的符文法印亮起，体内的葬天真气释放出来，一下子就变成了炽烈的火焰。
热浪扑面而来，火焰的温度竟然超出凡火几十倍，使得虚空都扭曲了起来。
“好啊！
有这三昧真火印相助，即便我的丹道经验还很浅薄，但也足以炼制出高品质的丹药。”
content_en:
The vast divine light dissipated, and peace finally returned to Burial Heaven Realm.
At this moment, Su Chen was bleeding from all his orifices and looked extremely miserable.
But Su Chen still relied on his super willpower to persevere and successfully completed the inheritance.
He has obtained the entire inheritance of the Hunyuan Dan Sutra!
Various elixir recipes, elixir ratios, fire control techniques, and the secrets of elixirs were all clearly imprinted in his sea of ​​consciousness.
"Not bad!"
The woman in white nodded lightly, and then disappeared.
After leaving the Burial Heaven Realm, Su Chen recovered after a short sleep and became more energetic, even his eyes exuded a frightening light.
"My mental strength has actually increased a lot!"
This discovery made Su Chen quite pleasantly surprised.
The most important thing for an alchemist is strong mental power.
There are nine levels of mental power. Only when the mental power is extremely condensed and reaches the first level, can you have the opportunity to practice alchemy and become an alchemist.
Among them, the first and second levels of mental power correspond to alchemy masters, the third and fourth levels of mental power correspond to alchemy masters, and the fifth and sixth levels of mental power correspond to alchemy masters.
As for those with spiritual power of seven levels and above, they are called alchemy saints, who are extraordinary and holy, possessing all kinds of mysterious powers.
Su Chen's mental power was already extremely extraordinary. After being tempered by the remaining mental power of the Hunyuan Alchemy God, his mental power reached the peak of the third level, already comparable to that of an alchemy master.
But these are just small scenes, the real big gain is the Hunyuan Dan Sutra.
The Hunyuan Alchemy Sutra includes the Hunyuan Alchemy God’s lifetime experience in alchemy, ancient special effects elixir recipes, and even powerful means of mastering the strange fires of heaven and earth.
Samadhi True Fire Seal!
Based on one's own energy and spirit, he creates the fire seal and condenses the strange fire of heaven and earth!
"This is the fire-controlling magic created by Hunyuan Dan God. After practicing it to great perfection, he can even turn the strange fires of heaven and earth into his own use. He is worthy of being a Dan God!"
Su Chen took a deep breath and praised.
For an alchemist, in addition to strong mental power, proficient alchemy skills and experience, the most important thing is the method of controlling fire.
Some clever fire control methods can even use ordinary fire to exert the power of real fire or even heavenly fire.
Not only can it greatly increase the success rate of elixir refining, shorten the elixir refining time, it can even improve the quality of the elixir.
To put it bluntly, if an ordinary alchemist and an alchemist who masters the method of controlling fire refine an elixir at the same time, their quality will be as different as clouds and mud.
Moreover, the method of controlling fire is a unique skill of alchemists and cannot be taught easily.
Therefore, the number of people who know how to do it is extremely rare.
The Samadhi True Fire Seal created by Hunyuan Dan God is definitely the most top fire control method in the world.
Even a person who doesn't know how to make alchemy can become a master of alchemy by mastering this method!
Buzz buzz...
According to the method recorded in the Hunyuan Dan Sutra, after Su Chen experienced repeated failures, he finally harnessed the power of his own energy and spirit, and condensed a faint mysterious seal in the Niwan Palace.
That was the prototype of the Samadhi True Fire Seal. Although it was still the most basic light red color, as Su Chen spent his energy and energy concentrating time and time again, the prototype of the flame gradually stabilized.
“This Samadhi True Fire Seal is really powerful!
My true energy, physical bloodline, and spiritual strength are far beyond those of ordinary people, yet it is actually so strenuous to practice. "
After just condensing the embryonic form, Su Chen felt that his body was hollowed out and completely exhausted.
Until Youyou woke up the next day, he turned his palm, and a mysterious and complex runic seal suddenly lit up. The Zhenzhen Qi in his body was released, and it suddenly turned into a blazing flame.
A heat wave hit his face, and the temperature of the flame was dozens of times higher than ordinary fire, causing the void to distort.
"Okay!
With the help of this Samadhi True Fire Seal, even though my experience in alchemy is still very shallow, it is enough to refine high-quality elixirs. "
